description:
Money Mirage uncovers the tricks, traps and true stories behind money — in under a minute.

Short illustrated stories about:
• Money history — the king who made gold cheap, the bubble that beat Isaac Newton
• Pricing tricks — fake discounts, "0% interest" EMIs, shrinkflation, prices ending in .99
• Scams — fake payment screenshots, video-call "arrests", pig butchering, Ponzi schemes

Every story ends with the mirage: what people believed vs what was really there. Facts are checked, with sources in each video's description.

New Shorts every day. Subscribe so the next money trick doesn't fool you.

For education and entertainment only — not financial advice. Scenes are AI-generated illustrations.
